hypothesis: Structured, requirement-linked feedback is preferred over generic feedback.
variant_b: structured feedback linked to matched and missed ground-truth requirements

design.position_balance: Each pair is shown twice across the study population with A/B order counterbalanced.

prohibited: claiming improvement from model-as-judge scores alone
discarding ties without reporting their count
changing the primary metric after viewing results
